cards.audioText: [Your call sign is SIA854, you are at Wuhan Airport, Stand 7, received ATIS M, request ATC clearance to Singapore.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你的呼号是新航854，你在武汉机场，7号机位，收到通播M，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA854, Stand 7, information M, destination Singapore, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航854，7号机位，通播M，目的地新加坡，申请ATC放行。

cards.audioText: SIA854, Wuhan Delivery, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, ZF-03D departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，武汉放行，可以按计划航路飞往新加坡，ZF-03D离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道18左，离场频率124.7，应答机4615。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, ZF-03D departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往新加坡，ZF-03D离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道18左，离场频率124.7，应答机4615，新航854。

cards.audioText: [Now you are ready for pushback and start-up, contact Wuhan Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已准备好推出开车，联系武汉地面。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA854, request pushback and start-up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航854，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA854, delay for pushback and start-up due flow control.[Read back the instructions and ask Ground how long the delay will be?]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，由于流量控制，推迟推出开车。【复诵指令并询问地面要延误多久。】
cards.referenceText: Standby, request how long will be delay, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 稍等，要延误多长时间？新航854。

cards.audioText: SIA854, delay about a few minutes.
[A few minutes later, contact Ground request a new clearance.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【几分钟后，联系地面请求新的放行许可。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA854, request pushback and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航854，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA854, pushback and start-up at own discretion.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，自行推出开车。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Pushback and start-up at own discretion, SIA854.

cards.audioText: [You have completed the pushback and start-up procedures, you decided to make an intersection departure from E2. Contact Ground to request intersection departure from E2.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【你已完成推出开车程序，决定从滑行道E2减跑道起飞。联系地面，请求从滑行道E2减跑道起飞。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA854, request an intersection departure from E2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航854，请求在滑行道E2减跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA854, intersection departure from E2 approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of runway 18L.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，可以在滑行道E2进跑道起飞。沿滑行道A6, A, A2滑行至滑行道E2，在跑道18左外等待。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E2 approved. Taxi to E2 via A6, A, A2. Hold short of runway 18L, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以从滑行道E2进跑道起飞。沿滑行道A6，A，A2滑至滑行道E2，在跑道18左外等待，新航854。

cards.audioText: [During taxiing, you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about this situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【滑行中，你发现滑行道A上有一抛锚车辆，你停下飞机，通知ATC该情况，请求机场服务拖走该车辆。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA854, there is a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, we stopped the aircraft, request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航854，滑行道A上有一抛锚车辆，我们停下飞机，请求机场服务拖走该车辆。

cards.audioText: SIA854, hold at present position. The ramp services will be there in a few minutes.[You are now holding short of runway 18L on E2. Request for departure.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，原地等待。机场服务几分钟后到。【你现在在滑行道E2，跑道18左外等待。请求离场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA854, holding short of runway 18L on E2. Request line up and departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航854，滑行道E2上跑道18左外等待。请求上跑道起飞。

cards.audioText: SIA854, Wuhan Tower, cleared for line up and takeoff, runway 18L.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，武汉塔台，可以进跑道起飞，跑道18左。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared for line up and takeoff runway 18L, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以进跑道18左起飞，新航854。

cards.audioText: [During the takeoff roll, your nose wheel ran over a sharp object on the runway surface and a nose wheel tire burst. You aborted takeoff. Notify Wuhan Tower and request fire engines and maintenance..]
cards.audioTextZh: 【起飞滑跑时，飞机前轮碾过锋利的道面上的锋利物体，前胎爆炸。你中止起飞。通知武汉塔台，请求消防车和维修服务。】
cards.referenceText: (Panpan Panpan Panpan) Wuhan Tower, SIA854, we aborted takeoff due ran over a sharp object and our nose wheel tire burst, request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: (Panpan Panpan Panpan) 武汉塔台，新航854，我们飞机前轮碾过道面上的锋利物体，前胎爆炸，中断起飞了，请求消防车和维修服务。

cards.audioText: SIA854, do you want any assistance?[Tell ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after initial inspection.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，需要援救么？【告诉ATC，你需要一辆拖车在初检后把飞机拖回停机坪。】
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request a tow truck back to the apron, SIA854.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，需要一辆拖车把飞机拖回停机坪，新航854。

cards.audioText: SIA854, the tow truck is on the way. Contact Ground 121.75.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航854，拖车马上到。联系地面121.75。【复诵】

cards.audioText: [Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron after contact Ground.]
cards.audioTextZh: 【联系地面，请求在停机坪处准备好客梯车及摆渡车。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA854, request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航854，请求在停机坪处准备好客梯车及摆渡车。
